Symptom: High vibration with feed-end bearing at 88 °C
Root Cause: Auto-lubricator reservoir empty - main bearing lubrication starvation
Why Chain: Vibration rising > Bearing hot and dry > Lubricator empty for a week > Level not on shift round and no alarm
Resolution: Regreased bearings, refilled and repaired lubricator, trended vibration for the shift
Preventive Action: Lubricator level on SLS checklist; low-level alarm wired to SCADA

Symptom: Low flow / choking with inlet backing up
Root Cause: Screen blinded by fibres from low wash water
Why Chain: Throughput low > Screen matted with fibres > Wash spray weak > Wash pressure 0.8 bar - strainer blocked > Strainer not on any schedule
Resolution: Cleaned screen under LOTO, cleaned strainer, restored 2.5 bar wash pressure
Preventive Action: Weekly strainer cleaning in PM; gauge fitted after strainer

Symptom: Vibration trip on restart after power failure
Root Cause: Solids set unevenly in bowl after unflushed stop
Why Chain: Vibration trip at run-up > Bowl imbalance > Solids left in stopped bowl > Flush pump also lost power
Resolution: Low-speed hot water flush for 40 min; vibration back to 2.5 mm/s
Preventive Action: Flush pump on DG board; PLC auto-flush on trip recovery

Root Cause: Polymer powder caked by humidity - lumpy solution
Why Chain: Centrate dirty > Poor flocs > Fish-eyes in polymer > Powder damp > Bags stored open on floor
Resolution: Discarded caked bags, fresh batch, jar test, dose raised to 8 kg/t DS
Preventive Action: Sealed dry polymer store on pallets; FIFO

Symptom: Some wash nozzles dead and patchy blinding
Root Cause: Nozzles choked by solids from recycled wash water
Why Chain: Patchy blinding > Dead nozzles > Nozzles choked with fibres > Recycled filtrate used for wash without fine filter
Resolution: Cleaned spray bar and nozzles, switched wash to service water
Preventive Action: Wash on clean service water; weekly nozzle check

Root Cause: Differential speed reduced too far by operator
Why Chain: Torque trips > Bowl plugging > Differential cut from 6 to 2 rpm > Operator chasing drier cake > No setpoint control or training
Resolution: Restored recipe 6 rpm, flushed bowl, restarted at 70 % feed
Preventive Action: HMI settings password-protected; setpoint log; operator training

Root Cause: Plastic film and twine wrapped on screw
Why Chain: Overload trip > Screw wrapped with plastic > Packaged waste in feed > No visual check at reception
Resolution: Removed plastic under LOTO; checked screen; informed supplier
Preventive Action: Visual contamination check at reception; feedstock spec to suppliers

Symptom: Torque creeping up and cake wetter over 6 weeks
Root Cause: Scroll flight tiles worn by grit
Why Chain: Torque creep > Scroll not conveying > Tiles worn 4 mm and cracked > High sand from press mud > No grit check at reception
Resolution: Rotating assembly re-tiled and dynamically balanced; feed zone liner replaced
Preventive Action: Sand test at reception; weekly torque trend at constant feed

Root Cause: Separator overfed while WAM 2 was out of service
Why Chain: Choking > Feed above rating > WAM 2 share pushed to others > No load-sharing rule
Resolution: Reduced feed pump speed, cleared inlet, spread feed
Preventive Action: Maximum feed per separator posted; reduce SLS feed when one is down

Root Cause: Gearbox oil overdue and contaminated - early gear wear
Why Chain: Torque hunting > Gearbox whine and metal in oil > Oil 4000 h overdue > Oil change and sampling not in PM
Resolution: Gearbox sent for OEM overhaul; standby rotating assembly fitted
Preventive Action: Gearbox oil change and 3-monthly sampling added to PM

Symptom: Fibres in filtrate and CDT sludge build-up
Why Chain: Fibres in filtrate > Screen torn 10 cm > Stone jammed between flight and screen > No stone trap upstream
Resolution: Replaced screen, straightened flight, desludged CDT inlet
Preventive Action: Stone trap on SLS feed line; weekly screen inspection

Symptom: High vibration alarm but machine running smoothly
Root Cause: Vibration sensor stud loose after maintenance
Why Chain: Alarm only > Handheld reading 2.1 mm/s > Sensor loose on housing > Not torqued after bearing job
Resolution: Re-torqued sensor stud and checked cable; alarm cleared
Preventive Action: Sensor torque check added to reassembly checklist

Root Cause: Counter-pressure flap weights moved to lowest position
Why Chain: Wet cake > Low counter-pressure > Weights moved to clear a plug > Never reset and no marked position
Resolution: Weights returned to commissioning mark; cake back to 30 % DM
Preventive Action: Commissioning position marked on machine; operators trained

Root Cause: Feed TS swinging - PST agitator tripped
Why Chain: Dirty centrate > Feed thick then thin > PST stratified > Agitator tripped and not noticed > No interlock with decanter feed
Resolution: Reset PST agitator, cut feed until TS steady, retuned polymer
Preventive Action: Decanter feed interlocked with PST agitator running; TS sampled each shift
